# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache eviction strategy, which evicts the least recently accessed items when the cache reaches capacity, with a cache TTL of 300 seconds. The recorded rationale is that LRU is easier to reason about and tune, favoring operational simplicity and predictability.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
